title: The payer's statement lists the invoice
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced for $210.00, billed to customer B, unpaid.
  • Make sure customer B owes nothing else.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer B's statement.
  2. Open customer A's statement.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer B's statement lists work order 1's invoice for $210.00 and a balance of $210.00.

Step 2:

  • Customer A's statement does not list work order 1's invoice.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12312 (Story 10, Receivables follow the Bill To)
